app_icon.initial: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production app icon for Jungle Academy, a gentle learning app for babies and toddlers. Create one beautiful square bitmap icon with a calm friendly baby tiger cub peeking over a small open cream storybook. Recognizable simple silhouette, warm orange fur, cream muzzle, large gentle dark eyes, closed smiling mouth, no teeth. Two or three restrained botanical jungle leaves frame the book. Match polished naturalistic children's storybook watercolor, soft hand-painted edges, gentle earthy green and ochre colors. All artwork comfortably inside central 65 percent of the square so it survives circular and rounded-square OS masks. Full square muted light sage green background, no transparent corners, no outer frame or rendered device. Strong readable shapes at 32 pixels. One icon only; no words, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, tiny clutter, grids or variants.
app_icon.refinement: Refine this Jungle Academy app icon. Keep its square sage background, small tiger with open book, warm natural watercolor and restrained botanical leaves. Give the tiger natural animal facial anatomy: remove the separate human-like eyebrows, replace them with ordinary tiger fur stripes, keep naturally shaped dark tiger eyes with small restrained highlights, natural whisker pads, and a relaxed closed feline mouth with no drawn human smile. Friendly through a calm young-animal expression. Preserve a clear small-icon silhouette and keep all important features inside the central 65 percent safe area. No words or letters. Do not add extra characters or objects.

logo: Create a horizontal Jungle Academy brand logo on a genuinely transparent background, using this reference's natural young tiger with an open storybook and a few botanical leaves as a small emblem on the LEFT. Preserve its gentle watercolor style and natural animal face, without human eyebrows or smile. Remove the square sage backdrop entirely. To the RIGHT write the exact two words 'Jungle Academy' in a beautiful, clean, highly legible warm dark-forest-green storybook serif wordmark, on two balanced lines if needed. The text must be spelled exactly J-u-n-g-l-e A-c-a-d-e-m-y, no other text. Balanced wide composition about 3:1 with generous clear margins, whole logo visible, no clipping, no frame, no shadows or opaque paper rectangle. One finished logo only.
